Stack, Barrenechea, Chirico, Colombo, Eddy, Fink, Fitzgerald, Gupta, Hobart, Mathrani, Ralls-Morrison, Schorr (W.D. Pa. 2:26-cv-02170; Weiser Law Firm). Claims are breach of fiduciary duty and unjust enrichment, with the Audit Committee singled out. The Relevant Period runs from 2025-09-08 'through the present'. It has no CWs and alleges no Europe sale, licensing or closure plan.
